image_description: A close-up view of a black rectangular instrument panel containing three circular dials. The largest dial on the left features a white face, a single pointer hand, and faint markings, consistent with an aneroid barometer. To the right, two smaller stacked dials are visible, likely a thermometer and hygrometer, forming a weather station unit. The casing appears to be black plastic or painted metal.
